verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a business-formation and registered-agent service, since such a service could ship a command-line tool for agentic workflows. However, the evidence pack contains nothing about one. The only first-party probe hit a Cloudflare challenge on robots.txt, so no product documentation was retrievable, and the community comment is about SEO, not tooling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
